text:
morgan: FYI premerge eval for release/2.14 failed the prompt-suite check on a few summarization prompts, small but consistent quality drift (~6% ROUGE-L drop)
jean: saw that. Which prompt sets and which metric exactly?
deploy-bot: preflight run 2026-06-12-09:12 failed. failed_checks: [summarizer_prompt_set:rouge_l:6.1%]; artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/preflight/2026-06-12-09-12
sara: 6% is noticeable. Was this on the canary model variant or baseline?
morgan: comparison against pinned model rwd-summa-v2@2026-05-03. The candidate is rwd-summa-v3@2026-06-10 (quantized). Drift concentrated on long-tail doc compression prompts.
jean: hmm quantization could explain token-level hallucinations lowering overlap. Any regressed examples in the report?
deploy-bot: top diffs: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/preflight/2026-06-12-09-12/diffs.txt
sara: quick skim — several examples where the new model truncates bullet points and drops details, not catastrophic but breaks downstream score gating.
tara: what are options: rollback, pin canary to previous model, or patch-selective rollback for summarizer route only?
morgan: we can pin the summarizer route in canary to rwd-summa-v2 while we triage v3. That keeps most of the release moving.
jean: agree. We should also add a changelog note and schedule a re-run after quantization tuning. Who can do the pin now?
sara: I can issue the pin. Command is:
```
redwood routes pin --route summarizer --model rwd-summa-v2@2026-05-03 --env canary --reason "preflight summarizer regression"
```
morgan: also document rollback criteria in the thread: if subsequent re-run still shows >4% regression vs baseline, escalate to rollback across all environments.
tara: +1. Add a Jira: RW-1829 for triage and quantization tuning, assign to jean.
jean: assigned and commented. I'll start a bisect on v3 to find the quantization commit.
deploy-bot: deploy action queued: pin summarizer route to rwd-summa-v2@2026-05-03 in canary. ticket=RW-1830
sara: pinned in canary. Confirmed traffic routing back to v2 for summarizer route. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: FYI ops — canary change window is active 09:30-10:30 PT, but this is low risk. Let me know if we need rollback or to widen window.
morgan: thanks — please keep oncall in loop. I'll update release notes: add entry under 2.14: "Temporarily pinned summarizer route in canary due to prompt eval regression; investigating quantization for v3."
tara: also add a short note to customers in #announcements if this affects any early access partners.
jean: starting bisect now, will post interim findings in this thread.
morgan: plan: (1) pin canary summarizer (done), (2) triage quantization and re-run preflight (jean), (3) if fixed, unpin and resume rollout, (4) if not fixed and regression >4% on re-run, schedule full rollback. Thanks everyone.
sara: created RW-1830 for the pin action and RW-1829 for triage. Linking them in the release board.
jean: first bisect candidate points to commit 3f9c7a -> quantize kernel change. Will test a non-quantized build next.
morgan: keep updates short here. If we need to notify customers I'll draft copy. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: next preflight re-run scheduled 2026-06-12-10:05 UTC.
jean: initial re-run (non-quantized) looks back within 0.8% of baseline. promising. continuing.
morgan: great. tagging this thread for the release notes and will close once we either unpin or schedule rollback."
